name: Limbokin
source:
You are a 12-year-old boy who has just upset your sister big-time. In an attempt to make up, you hide in her closet to surprise her. Maybe you can tackle-hug her while her defenses are down.

You die in the closet, wake up in purgatory.

[From [url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/limbokin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是个12岁的男孩，刚刚把姐姐惹得大发雷霆。为了和好，你躲进她的衣柜，想给她一个惊喜。也许可以趁她毫无防备，扑过去抱住她。

你死在了衣柜里，醒来时已身处炼狱。

[摘自[url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/limbokin]itch.io[/url]]
